label: Write a personal launch-day message to every interested reader with an AI copywriter
description: On launch day, writes every interested reader a personal message that mentions the story they commented on. The author approves each batch, then sends it by hand, since the networks do not allow automated replies to comments.

parameters.systemPrompt: Write a short, personal message in Croatian for each reader who has not been notified yet. Mention the story they commented on and quote a few words of their comment. Include the link https://REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN. No sales clichés. Return a document with one block per reader: name, network, profile link, message.

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Anthropic API key.
2. Google Docs connection.
3. The interested readers data table filled by the comment tracker template; replace REPLACE_WITH_INTERESTED_READERS_TABLE.
4. Replace REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN with your shop's address.
